info.title: WoxMail Master Suite REST & Streaming API
info.description: Complete, production-grade REST API reference for WoxMail: permanent mailboxes, temporary throwaway disposable mail, Enclave Vault confidential messages, Ephemeral Vector Streams, Time Capsule Future Letters, The Gatekeeper Cold Email Screener, WoxSMS, Developer CLI Gateway, Application Passwords, and Admin Management.

bearerAuth.description: Standard JWT Bearer token obtained from `/api/auth/login`.

appPasswordAuth.description: Developer SMTP / Application Password token formatted as `wox_app_xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx`.

apiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
apiKeyAuth.description: Developer CLI / API Key header for headless scripts and daemons.

tempSessionCookie.name: woxmail_temp
tempSessionCookie.description: Encrypted session cookie for temporary disposable mailboxes.

csrfToken.name: x-csrf-token
csrfToken.description: CSRF token required for state-mutating requests (POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH).

details.description: Optional error context or field validation errors

valid.description: True if syntax is valid and domain has active MX servers

suggestion.description: Auto-correct suggestion for domain typos (e.g. user@gmail.com)

token.description: Raw application password (returned only on creation)

post.description: Create a permanent @wox.world email account using an invite code.

400.description: Invalid username, password, or invite code

post.description: Authenticate with username/email and password. Returns JWT token and sets secure session cookie.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (too many login attempts)

post.description: Clears the authentication cookie and revokes the active session token.

get.description: Returns profile details, settings, and quotas for the currently authenticated user.

post.description: Generates a new TOTP secret and QR code data URI for Google Authenticator / Authy.
Confirms a TOTP token code to activate 2FA and generates 10 single-use emergency backup recovery codes.
Disables two-factor authentication after verifying user password.
Generates a fresh access token using a valid refresh token.

get.description: Fetches all IMAP folders (INBOX, Sent, Drafts, Trash, Spam, Archive, The Feed, Paper Trail) with total and unread counts.
Retrieves paginated message summaries for a folder with filtering and search support.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Filter search query by subject, sender, or content

get.description: Fetches complete email message details including sanitized HTML, plain text, headers, attachments, link previews, and security audit badges.
Validates email syntax, detects common domain typos (e.g. gamil.com -> gmail.com), and resolves DNS MX records to conserve SMTP bandwidth and prevent delivery failure.

post.description: Validates an array of recipient emails (To, CC, BCC) before batch sending.
Pre-validates recipients, sanitizes headers, dispatches outbound email via SMTP, and automatically appends an RFC822 copy to the user Sent folder.

200.description: Email sent and archived to Sent folder

400.description: Delivery blocked (invalid recipient MX or dead domain)

post.description: Sends a reply or Reply-All with proper In-Reply-To and References headers and appends to Sent.
Forwards a message along with original attachments and new recipient attachments.
Performs bulk operations (archive, delete, markRead, markUnread, star, unstar, move, spam) across multiple message UIDs simultaneously.

get.description: Streams the original unaltered raw RFC822 .eml message for cryptographic verification or backup.

200.description: Raw message/rfc822 file stream with Content-Disposition: attachment

get.description: Streams a specific attachment by index with safe Content-Security headers.

post.description: Instantly leases an ephemeral inbox from the pre-warmed pool on @mail.wox.world with configurable expiry.

password.description: Optional password to secure mailbox across devices

get.description: Fetches all incoming messages in a temporary mailbox with sender, preview, and receipt timestamps.
Long-lived HTTP event stream for zero-latency instant push notifications when new emails arrive in a disposable inbox.
Fetches complete sanitized HTML body, text, attachments, and headers for a temporary email.

post.description: Adds extra hours/days to an active temporary inbox lease.

delete.description: Immediately burns and expunges a temporary mailbox and all associated messages from the server.

get.summary: Generate QR Code for Temp Address
get.description: Returns a PNG QR Code representing the disposable address for seamless mobile sharing.
Returns all active application passwords / SMTP app codes for third-party clients (Thunderbird, iOS Mail, mutt, scripts).

post.summary: Generate New Application Password / SMTP App Code
post.description: Creates a 16-character revocable app token formatted as `wox_app_xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx` for legacy SMTP/IMAP or REST API access.

201.description: App password created. Token is shown ONCE.

example.message: Application password created successfully. Save this code now.

delete.description: Immediately invalidates an application password and terminates third-party access.

get.description: Fetches active confidential messages sent by the user with view limits, unlock counts, and expiry state.

post.description: Encrypts message payload with zero-knowledge AES-256-GCM, stores locked ciphertext, and delivers a vault notification to recipient with PIN authorization.

post.summary: Unlock Enclave Vault Message (Public / Guest Endpoint)
post.description: Verifies the 6-digit PIN code, decrypts the message payload, and increments view count / burns if 1-view limit is reached.
Transforms text into a dynamic SVG vector stream with anti-screenshot watermarks and 1-view self-destruct mechanism.

get.summary: Render In-Inbox Dynamic SVG Vector Stream
get.description: Serves dynamic image/svg+xml vector representation with burning timer and view destruction.

post.description: Schedules an email to be sent into the future (up to 50 years) with optional passcode lock and delivery confirmation.

passcode.description: Optional passcode required to view letter upon arrival

get.description: Lists all pending and delivered time capsules written by the user.

get.summary: Get Pending Senders in Screener Quarantine
get.description: Lists first-time senders held in the quarantine screener waiting for user decision.

post.description: Decides action for a screened sender (Inbox, The Feed, Paper Trail, or Block forever).

get.description: Retrieves all newsletter and marketing email campaigns with delivery telemetry.

post.description: Creates a mass broadcast campaign with template variable interpolation and unsubscribe handling.

get.description: Lists all registered webhook endpoints for inbound email events.

post.description: Registers a new HTTPS URL to receive instant JSON payloads for email events with HMAC-SHA256 signatures.
Initiates terminal authorization flow for the `wox` command-line interface.
Lightweight endpoint for terminal scripts, CI/CD pipelines, and cron daemons to send emails.

get.description: Returns server uptime, database pool health, redis status, and timestamp.
